release_read.basis: Revenue $245.4M is barely above the guide midpoint and the $245.06M bar (+0.1%, the smallest top-line beat of 2026), the FY revenue guide is only narrowed (965-966 vs 963.5-966.5) with NDR flat at 104%, so growth does not re-accelerate into a ServiceNow-scared tape; against that, non-GAAP op income $73.2M vs a $59-61M guide, EPS $0.22 vs $0.18 and a raised FY profit guide ($0.71 vs $0.66-0.68) plus $1B ARR. A name that has sold 6 of 7 beats: mild negative, well inside the 14.6% implied move.

key_line.detail: FY26 revenue guide $965.0-966.0M (~15%) vs prior $963.5-966.5M: midpoint +$0.5M, i.e. maintained/narrowed; Q4 revenue guide $253.5-254.5M (~14%); NDR 104% flat q/q, down from 105% y/y; multi-product EX deals +35%; >$1B ARR after quarter-end; Q3 buyback only $27.2M vs $159.1M a year ago. Release time is not stated in the 8-K; released_at_utc is an estimate (after the close, before the 17:00 ET call).

guidance.detail: Profit guide raised (FY non-GAAP op income $238-240M vs $222-228M; EPS ~$0.71 vs $0.66-0.68); revenue guide maintained (narrowed to $965-966M, ~15%). Street Q4 revenue consensus not found.

call.detail: Call held last night at 17:00 ET; no transcript or call summary reviewed in the time available, so nothing call-specific is in this read.

public_reaction.summary: One search found no post-print analyst actions or press coverage yet; latest found targets are September 2026 ($13-18, MarketBeat consensus ~$14.46). Tones set to 0 for lack of evidence, not as a reading.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 12.99 = -8.2% vs prev close 14.15 (last print 12.85 = -9.2% at 09:05; range 12.61-13.47; after-hours 13.50 = -4.6%), so it ran down from after-hours into the morning. 27 prints, 7 in the last 30 min, not stale. That is over 5x my -1.5% release read and roughly the size of the worst routine reactions, though inside the 14.6% implied move, and it comes against a strong tape (IWM +1.8%, SPY +1.2%). The short is +9.6% vs the 13:30 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis (sells routine beats, ITSM growth read on the ServiceNow standard) is playing out: an in-line top line with a revenue guide only narrowed is being sold despite a big margin beat. The size of the drop goes beyond what the release itself carries.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market (7 prints in the last 30 minutes) argues the open holds the move; a gap well beyond the release read, a profit beat and raise for dip buyers, and a strong small-cap tape argue the first half hour gives part of it back.

recommendation.reason: De short staat al ruim 9% in de winst en de koers zakt voorbeurs meer (-8%) dan de cijfers rechtvaardigen: de omzet is precies op verwachting, maar de winst is veel beter en de winstverwachting is verhoogd. Met een sterk stijgende markt is de kans groot dat een deel van de daling na de opening terugkomt, dus dek de short bij de opening, zoals de vaste regel ook zegt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs na 09:05 verder wegzakt tot onder 12,61 terwijl de markt omdraait, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 te overwegen.
